name: French Meringue
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ¼ tsp cream of tartar or a few drops lemon juice
8 oz (250 g) superfine sugar or sifted confectioners' sugar

steps: Whip the egg whites and cream of tartar until they reach soft peaks.
Add the first amount of sugar, little by little, while beating by hand or machine.
Stop beating and fold in the remaining sugar, if used, with a spatula.
Use as desired or in your recipe.

culture.text: Meringue is a type of dessert or candy, traditionally made from whipped egg whites and sugar, and occasionally an acidic ingredient such as lemon, vinegar, or cream of tartar. A binding agent such as salt, flour, or gelatin may also be added to the eggs. The key to the formation of a good meringue is the formation of stiff peaks by denaturing the protein ovalbumin via mechanical shear.
